data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses rogue as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses rogue as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Trapfinding: At 3rd level, she gains the trapfinding class feature.

&nl;Sneak Attack: At 7th level, she gains the sneak attack class feature. She can deal 1d6 points of extra damage. This extra damage increases by 1d6 for every 4 levels beyond 7th, to a maximum of 4d6 at 19th level.
&nl;Uncanny Dodge: At 15th level, she gains uncanny dodge. Improved Uncanny Dodge: At 19th level, she gains improved uncanny dodge, treating her character level as her effective rogue level.
